tools.name: auto_status
tools.description: Read the current state of the user's computer: local time, idle time, foreground window title when the deployment shares it, CPU load, memory, disk free space and uptime. Use it before deciding whether the user is busy.

summary.zh: 读一次时间、空闲时长、前台窗口、CPU、内存和磁盘。
summary.en: Reads time, idle time, foreground window, CPU, memory and disks.

tools.name: auto_look
tools.description: Capture the screen (all monitors, scaled down) as a JPEG image so you can see what the user is doing. The image is attached only when the deployment allows screenshots and the active model accepts images; otherwise the receipt explains why.

summary.zh: 截一张全屏图交给模型看，模型不支持图片时只回文字。
summary.en: Captures the screen as an image for the model; text only when images are unsupported.

tools.name: auto_plan
tools.description: Report the proactive-interaction plan: when the next check is due, how many invitations were sent today, whether a quiet period is active and whether now is inside the allowed hours.

summary.zh: 报频率、保底进度、今日次数、安静期和是否在活跃时段。
summary.en: Reports the frequency, pity progress, today counts, quiet period and whether now is inside the hours.

tools.name: auto_quiet
tools.description: Stop initiating contact for a while. Use it when the user is busy, in a meeting or asks not to be interrupted. 0 cancels an active quiet period.

minutes.description: How long to stay quiet, in minutes. 0 cancels.

summary.zh: 安静一段时间，不再主动搭话。
summary.en: Stays quiet for a while and stops initiating contact.

tools.name: auto_pace
tools.description: Temporarily scale how often you get woken up. 0.5 halves it, 2 doubles it; the change expires after the given minutes. Use it when the screen shows the user busy or ready to hang out. Only available when the deployment allows it.

factor.description: Multiplier on the hit probability; 1 leaves it unchanged.

minutes.description: How long the change lasts, in minutes. Defaults to 90.

summary.zh: 按屏幕内容临时调高或调低出现频率，到点自动恢复。
summary.en: Scales the wake-up rate for a while, then restores it.

description.zh: World 挂载完成，记下当前的节奏。
description.en: The World was mounted and recorded its rhythm.

description.zh: 到点且通过全部条件，邀请模型决定要不要主动开口。
description.en: A check passed every condition; the model is invited to speak up.

description.zh: quiet 工具设下或取消了安静期。
description.en: The quiet tool set or cleared a quiet period.

prompts.title: 主动互动 · 环境提示词
